subject: Eval guardrail + ops handshake for prompt-set rollout
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Teresa Moreno <teresa@blueinc.com>, Acme AI <eng@acme.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Eval guardrail + ops handshake for prompt-set rollout

Team —

Quick sync request as we prepare the prompt-set A/B rollout for Acme next week. Product asks we lock down the acceptance criteria and the ops handoff so we can sign the canary and schedule the dedicated capacity. Key asks below: 

1) Acceptance thresholds (prompt-set A vs B): suggested draft in attached workbook. I want concrete pass/fail rules for the AB job so SRE/ops can automate rollback.
2) Regression signals to monitor: functional accuracy delta, P95 latency, hallucination rate (human-rated), and support ticket spike.
3) Rollback policy: who triggers (ops vs product), quick rollback playbook, and fallback model variant.
4) Canary timeline & ops checklist (traffic ramp, monitoring runbooks, alerting thresholds).

Attachments: eval_acceptance_draft.xlsx (contains proposed numeric thresholds) and ab-plan-v1.md (AB plan draft).

Can each of you reply with a single line for: (a) comfortable thresholds or objections, (b) any ops constraints (capacity/quantization variants), and (c) owner for the on-call rollback runbook? I'd like to capture decisions and then fold into the runbook by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Product — Evals
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval guardrail + ops handshake for prompt-set rollout

Grace — thanks for the clear list. Quick replies inline: 

(a) Acceptance thresholds (I'm suggesting we land on these now):
- Human-rated coherence: mean >= 4.1 (5-point scale) for B vs A
- Accuracy-based metrics: absolute drop <= 1.5 percentage points for task-specific F1
- Hallucination: manual samples <= 2% flagged in two random buckets of 500 prompts
- Latency: P95 increase <= 10% vs baseline

(b) Ops constraints: we have a scheduled GPU maintenance window Thu night (4/22) — avoid heavy canary ramp during that window. Also, the quantized 4-bit variant shows ~6% latency improvement but we must validate numeric fidelity; recommend initially using float16 variant for canary.

(c) Runbook owner: I can own the acceptance checklist and coordinate the human-rater sampling. Ben/ops should own rollback automation.

I attached brief comments to eval_acceptance_draft.xlsx.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, Evals
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval guardrail + ops handshake for prompt-set rollout

+1 to Marissa's thresholds. A couple of operational notes: 

- Rollback trigger set: automated if any two of {human-rated drop > 0.5 points, F1 drop > 2pp, P95 latency > 15%}, OR manual rollback if support ticket rate jumps > 200% vs baseline over a 30m window. We should avoid too many simultaneous criteria; suggest we pick the automated pair above and keep the rest for manual triage.
- Owner: Ops (me) will own automation + playbook. I'll prepare a dry-run and a one-click rollback script for the canary.
- Fallback variant: float16 checkpoint pinned to the last approved model (v1.4). We can test quantized after canary completes.

Also tagging Jordan for the tracing hooks & dashboards he mentioned earlier.

Ben
Ben Carter
SRE — Inference Platform
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval guardrail + ops handshake for prompt-set rollout

Thanks all — summarizing so we have an actionable handoff (copying external Acme contacts for visibility).

Decisions: 
- Acceptance thresholds: human-rated coherence >= 4.1; F1 drop <= 1.5pp; hallucination manual sample <= 2% (two 500-sample buckets); latency P95 increase <= 10%.
- Rollback automation: trigger when any TWO of {human-rated drop > 0.5, F1 drop > 2pp, P95 latency > 15%} are breached. Support spike (>200% in 30m) is a manual escalation.
- Fallback model: float16 v1.4 pinned. No quantized variant during initial canary.
- Ops constraints: no heavy ramp during Thu 4/22 maintenance window.

Owners & next steps: 
- Marissa: finalize human-rater instructions and sampling buckets by EOD 2027-04-21.
- Ben: prepare automated rollback script, dry-run in staging, and the ops checklist by 2027-04-21.
- Jordan: deliver tracing dashboard (P95 latency, per-route error rate, hallucination sampling link) by 2027-04-21.
- Grace: confirm canary start window with Acme (Grace to propose two 2-hour windows in 4/23-4/24).

Related docs: https://redwood-gdrive.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c (eval workbook), HUBSPOT-ACME-2319.

I'll update the runbook and move this into the infra repo after Ben's dry-run. If no objections, I'll close this thread and create the checklist PR.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Inference Platform
